purpose: 노하우 흡수 (owner 2026-09-28 '노하우 흡수 온톨로지를 만들어놔'): turn a video/article/tool that teaches a method (쇼츠 부업, 수익화, 소싱, 편집 도구) into a checked, reusable record — what the steps are, what is only claimed, what breaks our rules, and what we adopt, adapt, test or reject, wired to the pipeline component that would change. Complements reference-knowledge (source observations → claims → tasks); entries live in research/content-store/knowhow/*.json and are validated by knowhow.mjs.

classes.label: 노하우
classes.description: A reproducible method someone teaches or a tool enables (one entry file).

classes.label: 출처
classes.description: Video, article, repo or post the method was learned from; access records what could actually be read (full transcript, description+chapters, docs).

classes.label: 단계
classes.description: One action of the method, in order, with its source locator (time range or section).

classes.label: 도구
classes.description: Software/service used by a step, with license and cost.

classes.label: 주장
classes.description: A statement the source makes: result (돈·조회수), mechanism (why it works), requirement, or fact; carries an evidence level.

classes.label: 위험
classes.description: Why a step could hurt us (copyright, platform policy, affiliate terms, 표시광고, account, bot defense, cost, quality).

classes.label: 채택 판단
classes.description: adopt | adapt | test | watch | reject, with reasons and per-step replacements.

relations.description: adapt: the step is done our way instead.

evidenceLevels.label: 주장만 있음
evidenceLevels.use: never stated as fact in our content; numbers stay attributed ('~라고 주장')

evidenceLevels.label: 공식 문서·약관
evidenceLevels.use: may drive rules (e.g. YPP thresholds, affiliate terms)

decisions.label: 바꿔서 채택
decisions.requires: every blocked step has a replacement

decisions.label: 시험
decisions.requires: no unmitigated blocker; a task with acceptance criteria

rules.text: A claim at evidence 'claimed' is never used as fact; published text attributes it to the source.
adopt/test are invalid while any risk of severity 'blocker' has no mitigation.
adapt requires, for every step threatened by a blocker, a replacement naming our component or method.
Every step and claim cites a source id and a locator (time range 'mm:ss-mm:ss', section, or 'description').
test and adapt decisions yield at least one task with acceptance criteria.
Source.access says what was actually read; a method learned only from a title/description is marked access 'description' and cannot claim step detail beyond the chapters.

sources.rule: Defines a how-to procedure with steps, tools, supplies, estimated cost, and time-related properties.
Defines individual steps within a how-to procedure.
Supports accurate titles, readable organization, original information, and clear use of sources.

sources.kind: GitHub REST API, schema.org vocabulary repository
sources.rule: 6,262 stars; last pushed 2026-09-24T08:52:55Z. Repository metadata for the vocabulary used by the HowTo and HowToStep types.

sourcedAdditions.value: For procedural how-tos, record steps, tools, supplies, estimated cost, and preparation, performance, and total time only when supported; leave unknown values unset.
sourcedAdditions.why: Aligns how-to records with established procedural fields without requiring unsupported estimates.

sourcedAdditions.value: Use accurate, descriptive titles and readable sections for how-to content; do not promise a search-ranking result.
sourcedAdditions.why: Adds official platform guidance to the existing source and evidence requirements.
